scope: Client navigation from localized contact pages to localized privacy pages
finding: The previous page and destination x-default alternates could remain connected simultaneously under HTML/HEAD after an App Router navigation.
workaround: Use localized document anchors for the two links to Privacy so the destination receives a complete document head.
limitation: This workaround covers only the Contact-to-Privacy links. It does not establish that metadata reconciliation is fixed for every App Router client navigation.
